description_en: Accurately detects key information from real estate certificates, including owner details, property address, area size, land rights type, and more. It supports recognition of various property certificates issued across different regions in China
description_zh: 可准确识别不动产证中的各项关键信息，包括户主信息、房屋地址、面积大小、土地权利类型等，适用于全国各地的不同房产证识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-estate-certification --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1idy2XDZmx1VjSZFGXXax2XXa-713-1133.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEstateCertification
